children: REVENUE UP 21.7%, TATA CO enhances FY27 GROWTH GUIDANCE Our Bureau New Delhi: Tata Group firm Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) reported a 19.35% increase in net profit for the second quarter of this financial year to about 380 crore, up from around 318 crore a year ago.

The company's revenue from operations rose 21.7% year-on-year to 2,484 crore in July-September. IHCL MD and CEO Puneet Chhatwal said the company is set to achieve its Accelerate 2030 target of a 700-hotel portfolio well ahead of time. He said the company is also upgrading its consolidated revenue guidance for 2026-27 to 15-17% from 12-14%, led by 17-19% hotel segment revenue with seasonally strong quarters ahead, "high demand" from social and MICE (meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions) events and a strong non-like-for-like growth. "Quarter two was a record quarter for us in terms of all key metrics such as topline, Ebitda (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation) and profit after tax.

Based on our performance in the first half of this fiscal, we are revising our consolidated revenue guidance. October looks very strong and we expect very encouraging growth in quarter three as well," said Chhatwal. "We are expecting a very strong not like for like growth as we will open 30 hotels in the second half of this fiscal, up from 20 in the first half." Ebitda stood at 788 crore, and Ebitda margin at 30.7%, he said. "The revenue drivers were a rise of 25% in revenue per available room from domestic same store hotels, a 25% increase in management fee income led by new openings momentum and a 25% revenue growth in the select service business and the contribution from our recent acquisitions of Brij and Atmantan," said Chhatwal. "With 47 signings in the first half across the brandscape, IHCL today is a portfolio of 670 hotels and is set to achieve its guidance under Accelerate 2030 of a 700-hotel portfolio well ahead of time," he added. Ankur Dalwani, executive vice president and chief financial officer, said IHCL Consolidated reported a gross cash of 4,369 crore as of September 30.

title: IHCL Posts Strong Q2 Led by Growth in RevPAR, Fees
